product.title: Chinatown, Little India, Kampong Gelam City Highlights Tour

description.text: In Singapore, this three-hour licensed heritage walk covers Kampong Glam, Little India including Tekka Centre, and Chinatown including Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and Museum. The meeting is the Let's Go Tour shop on Crawford Lane; the published end is Chinatown Complex. Commentary stays on Chinese, Indian, and Malay street history and photo stops rather than included tastings. Gratuities are listed separately. The route is a compact three-quarter introduction rather than a 5.5-hour food day. The format suits visitors who want guided heritage streets without booking three neighbourhood walks independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on Kampong Glam, Little India, Tekka Centre, and Chinatown that shape this outing rather than a Gardens by the Bay night show.
